newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota plans output on extra days in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Toyota plans output on extra days in Nov.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp's plants and its affiliates will operate for extra days in November to boost production to keep up with orders, a Toyota spokeswoman said on Friday.
Its five domestic plants will operate for one to three extra days in November.
Kanto Auto Works Ltd and Toyota Auto Body Co Ltd will operated three extra days each in November.
Hino Motors Ltd, Daihatsu Motor Co Ltd, and unlisted Araco Corp will operate for two extra days in November to produce Toyota cars.
Toyota owns 48.6 percent of Kanto Auto and has a 45.2 percent stake in Toyota Auto Body, 11 percent in Hino, 33.4 percent in Daihatsu and 75 percent in Araco.
Toyota's new models such as the Mark II, Chaser, Cresta, Land Cruiser Prado, HiLux Surf, Ipsum, Carina, Windom, Starlet, Estima Lucida and Estima Emina are in good demand in Japan.
